entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri A.Rajeshwar Rao through Video conferencing along
with Shri Shubham Patel - Advocates for the Economic Offences Wing.
Heard on I.A.No.31160/2025 - an application for interim bail .
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the applicant is facing trial for offences under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.

He has further submitted that his elder sister namely Ms. Leena Ekka was unmarried and was living with the applicant, but due to her illness, she passed away on 30-12-2025 and her dead body is shifted in mortuary.
As per custom, for last ceremony, the applicant is the only male person, who will be performing all the customary ceremonies of his sister.
He prayed for interim bail.
The counsel appearing through Video Conferencing of the EOW submitted that the sister of the applicant has died on 30.12.2025, but opposed the release of applicant on interim bail.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on interim bail.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail temporarily on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
It is directed that applicant shall surrender immediately after completion of interim bail i.e. on 19.01.2026 before the concerned trial Court.
Surrender report shall be submitted by the concerned Court to the Office of this Court for information.
It is also directed that if applicant fails to surrender, the concerned trial Court shall take appropriate steps for securing his arrest.
Accordingly, the said I.A. No.31160/2025 stands disposed off.
Certified copy today.
List this case after two weeks.
